title: I think the hardest part of trading is how quickly it changes your confidence
author: collosal01
selftext:
It’s strange how one good week can make you feel like you’ve finally figured everything out.  
Then one bad week comes along and suddenly you’re questioning every decision you’ve ever made.  
The charts haven’t changed.  
Your strategy probably hasn’t changed.  
But somehow your confidence has.  
I’ve started to realise that managing that swing is almost as important as managing risk itself.
